title.suggested: Allen said to back "Dutch" Niel against Johnnie Daly

summary.suggested: The St. Louis Post-Dispatch reported that "Dutch" Niel's representative said Tom Allen would back Niel against Johnnie Daly in a 140-pound glove finish fight for $500 a side.

metadata.notes: No masthead in the clipping and no page image; date and paper taken from the source file name (Thu., Nov. 10, 1892).

facts.fact: "Dutch" Niel's representative said Allen would back Niel against Johnnie Daly in a skin-tight glove finish contest at 140 pounds for $500 a side, and that Daly could find Niel at Allen's to talk business

notes: Secondhand claim; Allen denied the $500 backing two days later (article 150).
